esg.title: ESG character
esg.lead: Every project advances a UN Sustainable Development Goal, not just a business idea.
esg.detail: We choose projects by which SDG they move forward — impact is the entry ticket, not an afterthought.

execution.title: Risk-free execution
execution.lead: You found a real company without carrying the personal risk of founding one.
execution.detail: The association carries liability, structure, and process — you bring the idea, the team, and the execution.

network.title: International network
network.lead: You become part of a network of universities and alumni that reaches far beyond Mannheim.
network.detail: National and international competitions, partner companies, and an active alumni network open doors beyond your degree.

benefit-1.title: Responsibility
benefit-1.lead: You take on real responsibility for a project from day one.
benefit-1.detail: Not an internship that runs alongside you — you make operational decisions and own the results.

benefit-2.title: Practical skills
benefit-2.lead: You learn skills your degree rarely covers.
benefit-2.detail: From bookkeeping to sales to legal basics — practical knowledge you need right away, not just theory.

benefit-3.title: Network
benefit-3.lead: You build a network that outlasts your studies.
benefit-3.detail: Partner companies, alumni, and other Enactus teams worldwide become part of your professional network.

benefit-4.title: Leadership
benefit-4.lead: You take on leadership responsibility long before your first job asks for it.
benefit-4.detail: Project lead, team lead, budget responsibility — roles that would otherwise take years of experience.

benefit-5.title: Your résumé
benefit-5.lead: You gain an experience that stands out on a résumé.
benefit-5.detail: Co-running a real social business is a different thing from one more seminar.

benefit-6.title: Community
benefit-6.lead: You become part of a community working on the same causes.
benefit-6.detail: Weekly collaboration with people who share the same conviction you do.

thorben-ossig.bio: Responsible for the board's strategy and its execution, and for contact with our Enactus Global network.

anton-osuhovskiy.bio: Responsible for project controlling, accounting, and legal compliance for the project work and the association.

tom-iizuka.bio: Responsible for the project portfolio and for building and deploying the association's resources for the projects' success.

philip-strobl.bio: Responsible for the innovation process, giving members the best possible support with network and knowledge during idea iteration.

risto-terhart.bio: Responsible for culture through socials and journeys, and for communication through marketing.

smilegreen.oneLiner: The uncompromising replaceable-head toothbrush made from natural rubber.
smilegreen.description: SmileGreen develops a replaceable-head toothbrush made from natural rubber with PHA bio-plastic bristles. It's 100% compostable within four months and, through a hygienic replaceable-head system, offers a sustainable alternative to the disposable toothbrush.

STAR_1.description: Blauherz developed trousers for wheelchair users that combine functional and fashionable demands. The project ran from 2016 to its spin-off in 2019 and was also a 2019 World Cup finalist.

STAR_2.description: Moufense is an anti-mosquito body lotion against malaria in Togo, its effectiveness confirmed by the Biogents institute in Regensburg. Distribution ran through the Kopeme Group; the project won the National Cup in 2021.

STAR_3.description: effishent ran aquaponics in Togo — the symbiotic farming of fish and vegetables in a closed water cycle. The process was designed to be affordable for developing countries too.

STAR_4.description: Sanagua gave the population of Arica, Chile, access to clean and affordable drinking water. The project was successfully spun off.

STAR_5.description: Back on Track helped a former inmate into a full-time position running his own vegan food truck.

STAR_6.description: Flat Mates reached the National Cup final round in 2013.

STAR_7.description: Stadthonig was handed over to a partner.

STAR_8.description: Sunte brought solar power and education to hospitals in Togo.
